rules.summary: File name is not NNNN-lowercase-title.md
Two files share a number
Numbering has a gap
Heading is not '# NNNN. Title' or its number differs from the file name
Status or Date line is missing
Status is not proposed, accepted, rejected, deprecated or superseded
Date is not a real YYYY-MM-DD date
A required section is missing (Context, Options considered, Decision, Consequences)
Fewer than two options are recorded
The Decision does not name the option it chose
Consequences lacks a non-empty Good or Bad subsection
Supersedes or Superseded by points to an ADR that does not exist
A supersession link is not reciprocal
Status and Superseded by disagree
Template placeholder text is still present
Proposed for longer than the stale limit
No Review section
Title is longer than 80 characters
Decision section is longer than 150 words
Date is in the future
